## Context

- CORS is only documented as a manual **`set_middleware`** use case. Teams expect **`allow_origins` / `allow_methods` / `allow_headers`** in one place, plus correct preflight for `OPTIONS`.
- See [Feature gaps](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/docs/feature.md#4-безопасность-кроме-jwt).

## Direction

- Ship a **Python** helper (e.g. `CORSConfig` + `apply_cors(app, config)` or a factory for `set_middleware`) that returns `None` to continue, or a short preflight/response for allowed origins.
- Do not break existing single-middleware contract; document interaction if a user also sets `set_middleware` for other reasons (order / composition).

## Acceptance criteria

- Pytest: browser-like preflight and a simple cross-origin `GET` with `Origin` header receive expected CORS headers.
- Short section in `docs/handlers.md` or a dedicated `docs/cors.md` linked from the index.

## Research

- Starlette `CORSMiddleware` defaults; RSGI `scope` / headers available on the middleware entry point already.
